saison.theme: Ultimate frisbee : le disque, le terrain, l'esprit du jeu

style: Flat graphic illustration in the style of a bold linocut / woodblock print. Thick dark ink outlines (#16150F), flat color fills, a limited palette of at most 5 colors per image built on cream paper tones with one or two vivid accents, subtle paper grain, slightly rough printed edges. Charming, characterful and a little fierce, like a collectible game emblem. No text, no letters, no watermark, no frame, no border.
formatAvatar: Format: square 1:1. A single character or emblem centered, filling about 70% of the frame with safe margins on every side, on a plain flat solid background of color {fond}. It will be cropped into a circle, so keep everything inside the central circle. One image only.
formatCouverture: Format: wide banner 16:9. Keep the key subject inside the middle horizontal band (central 40% of the height) because the top and bottom will be cropped. Atmospheric wide scene, no close-up faces. One image only.
